about: Places that opened or changed after the map sources were captured. The aerial imagery is dated 2024-01 and the building footprints are older still, so anything newer is missing or wrong unless it is listed here. The owner adds to this list; an agent fills in what it can from footage. Used by work package 9 step 9.

places.name: Knots
places.status: Opening and contractor references confirm the name, main road and distinctive yellow and blue frontage. The access is present per the owner’s trial drive. The property and building orientation still need matching to recent imagery before placement.

places.name: Clutch N' Carb
places.kind: car dealership with a coffee shop
places.status: Showroom pin and main road confirmed. The 2023 footage shows a large metal-roofed hall. The street-facing wall and sign position still need matching across the forecourt.

places.name: Karting Mania
places.opened: before 2022; not new, but absent from OpenStreetMap
places.status: Aerial survey preview tested in CSP. The exact timed layout remains open in WP11.

places.name: Winner Force Kousba
places.status: Official pin and storefront matched to the street-facing wall of the adjacent mapped footprint. The private override places the photographed sign on one storefront bay.

places.name: Spinneys The Hub
places.status: Maliks inside the store provides the verified pin. A newer satellite view shows the new approximately 1,792 m² roof and the replaced shed. The private override uses the traced exterior, reconstructed blue glass and yellow trim, and lettering rectified from the opening photo. The contractor night photo shows white signs and warm fascia lighting. Check the forecourt surface during the ground-texture pass.

places.name: Stories Coffee
places.status: Official listing confirms the Amioun branch. Ehden Road Plus Code 7RXC+F76 points to the edge of a vacant plot in the accessible current satellite view. Identify the occupied unit or newer build from a street-level photo.

places.name: Nosh Cafe
places.status: Business-attributed photo matched to the existing red-roofed footprint beside the spur. The private override includes the black gable front and photographed sign.

entry_fields: name, kind, village, lat, lon (or a description of where), side_of_road (left or right when driving in a stated direction), opened, sign_text, floors, new_building (true if the building itself is new, false if a shop opened in an existing building), photo (file under recordings/photos/), sources (public reference links), status (what was confirmed and what needs checking)
